answer: A clone is minted only when an existing agent spends one of its own attestation slots this epoch to draw a zephyr seed, and every vine child must commit its first answer to the parent's latest answer hash. The cedar audit samples seed fan-out per parent: over-K minted children freezes the parent's bond, and the commit link makes each fork detectable. Attacker cost: a sacrificed mining slot plus frozen collateral per clone.
